THIS CASE COMES ON CALENDAR, HAVING BEEN ASSIGNED BY PRESIDING JUDGE DAVID BALLATI, FOR HEARING ON LABOR APPEAL. APPELLANT'S WITNESS AFFIRMED AND EXAMINED; APPELLANT RESTS. RESPONDENT'S WITNESS AFFIRMED AND EXAMINED; RESPONDENT RESTS. THE COURT ORDERS COUNSEL FOR RESPONDENT TO PREPARE AND SUBMIT PROPOSED JUDGMENT TO COURT. THIS MATTER WILL BE TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION FOR DECISION WHEN PROPOSED JUDGMENT IS SUBMITTED TO THE COURT. VJ PAUL H. ALVARADO; CSR: NICI RODICH 11604, CLERK: LESLEY FISCELLA (210).
PROPOSED JUDGMENT SUBMITTED BY COUNSEL FOR DEFENDANT; PER APRIL 23, 2007 ORDER OF THE COURT, THIS MATTER IS TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION ON APR-27-2007 BY PAUL H. ALVARADO. (LAF, 210).
COURT SIGNS JUDGMENT SUBMITTED BY THE DEFENDANT - JUDGMENT ENTERED. VJ PAUL H. ALVARADO, CLERK: LESLEY FISCELLA (210).

THE COURT ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS HEREBY ORDERED, ADJUDGED AND DECREED THAT THE DECISION OF THE LABOR COMMISSIONER, AND THE DETERMINATION ON APPEAL THEREFROM, BE, AND HEREBY ARE, AFFIRMED IN FULL; IT IS FURTHER ORDERED THAT JUDGMENT SHALL BE ENTERED HEREIN IN FAVOR OF RESPONDENT UNITED COLLECTION CORPORATION. SEE SCANNED DOCUMENT.
